experiment: causal quality and strict purpose budget 2x2

cash_policy.cap_definition: Sum of exact P-funded acquisition basis in surviving lots plus pending P claims. Settlement retires acquisition basis exactly once; returns require fresh authorization.
cash_policy.partial_proceeds: All net partial proceeds return to PARK exactly once, as in native control.
cash_policy.whole_proceeds: Exact P-funded ownership fraction returns to PARK; ordinary-funded remainder rotates as in native control.
cash_policy.priority: Original EXIT then PARTIAL_RECYCLE then RECOVERY then ENTRY. Native recovery planning priority is preserved; no new adaptive ranking is implied.

unchanged.entry_selection: Original causal movement and recorded-volume ranking; not a predictive winner selector.
unchanged.recovery_selection: Original fingerprint/recovery/tranche planners; no new ladder or signal overlay.

stops: Any accounting, ownership, sourcecap or causal cutoff violation
SHARED_RAW differs from exact audited BOTH control
Execution budget reached; preserve incomplete evidence
No authentic parked fill: mark inactive/inconclusive, do not relax thresholds
execution.result_selection: Compare complete window marked equity, change in open P&L, cash, source utilization, drawdown, and fees. Do not select by realized profit alone.

limits: This July continuation is a bounded mechanism and policy comparison, not a new January-June backtest.
The period and original native baseline were previously inspected; this is not an untouched performance holdout.
No new freshness/history gate, predictive winner model, live execution or thirty-second execution guarantee is tested.
A good result warrants longer validation; it does not approve deployment or guarantee profitability.
This gate pair is exploratory rule-based qualification, not trained AI, proof of predictive edge, or a hindsight coin allowlist.
Budget and quality effects are compared independently; per-kind budgets cannot borrow from each other.
900-second operational cap is frozen before this new matrix and has no financial meaning.

quality_policy.scope: Parked supplement only; ordinary cash first; original native selection/planners/floors preserved
quality_policy.entry: Actual finite positive close now, exactly 1h ago and exactly 24h ago; both strict returns >0
quality_policy.recovery: Six contiguous actual finite positive 5m candles; close now > close 15m ago, and minimum low of last three > minimum low of preceding three
quality_policy.decision_cutoff: Completed current 5m candle end; all referenced indices <= current index; no execution bar inspected
quality_policy.sparse: Missing exact anchors or any missing six-bar recovery row denies parked supplement; never forward fill
quality_policy.ranking: Original absolute-movement and recorded-volume ranking preserved; no asset-specific hindsight list
quality_policy.initial_warmup: Read canonical pre-July tape only as causal history, without resetting native hydrated buffers

selection_gate.no_production_promotion: Improvement in this previously viewed July window still needs wider/untouched validation
